g.text: R1, R2, R3 and R5 sit on the supply side of their LED so that, on the board, another track can pass between their pads (one copper layer, no vias).

g.desc: R1, R2, R3 and R5 sit on the supply side of their LED so that, on the board, another track can pass between their pads (one copper layer, no vias).

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the AA light and the transistor. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the AA light and the transistor. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: AA (D1) shows that the switched supply VLOAD is present. All six lights use the house 1.3 k resistor (the maker used 47 ohm).

g.desc: AA (D1) shows that the switched supply VLOAD is present. All six lights use the house 1.3 k resistor (the maker used 47 ohm).

g.text: in every switch position (they never touch VLOAD). SYN (D6) is lit by whatever the user wires to pad TP1 (board-only bare pad, net SYN; no schematic symbol).

g.desc: in every switch position (they never touch VLOAD). SYN (D6) is lit by whatever the user wires to pad TP1 (board-only bare pad, net SYN; no schematic symbol).

g.text: A light is on while its line is LOW: OH follows SCL, SD follows SDA. RTS (D4) and CTS (D5) are lit directly by the badge's GPIO1 / GPIO2 pins, about 1 mA each when high,

g.desc: A light is on while its line is LOW: OH follows SCL, SD follows SDA. RTS (D4) and CTS (D5) are lit directly by the badge's GPIO1 / GPIO2 pins, about 1 mA each when high,

g.text: Q1 = two P-channel MOSFETs (the maker's DMP3085LSD). SCL and SDA only touch the gates, through R7 / R8: an insulated input, so the bus cannot feed the board or the cell.

g.desc: Q1 = two P-channel MOSFETs (the maker's DMP3085LSD). SCL and SDA only touch the gates, through R7 / R8: an insulated input, so the bus cannot feed the board or the cell.

g.text: (this board is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2): nothing can push current back into the CR2032.

g.desc: (this board is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2): nothing can push current back into the CR2032.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other. D7 is the series cell diode docs/standard.md section 3 requires

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other. D7 is the series cell diode docs/standard.md section 3 requires
